legend: Alice became interested in periods of integer numbers. We say positive X%%ZSMJ0%% integer number is periodic with length L%%ZSMJ1%% if there exists positive integer number P%%ZSMJ2%% with L%%ZSMJ3%% digits such that X%%ZSMJ4%% can be written as PPPP…P%%ZSMJ5%%. For example:
X=123123123%%ZSMJ6%% is periodic number with length L=3%%ZSMJ7%% and L=9%%ZSMJ8%%
X=42424242%%ZSMJ9%% is periodic number with length L=2,L=4%%ZSMJ10%% and L=8%%ZSMJ11%%
X=12345%%ZSMJ12%% is periodic number with length L=5%%ZSMJ13%%

For given positive period length L%%ZSMJ14%% and positive integer number A%%ZSMJ15%%, Alice wants to find smallest integer number X%%ZSMJ16%% strictly greater than A%%ZSMJ17%% that is periodic with length L.
input: First line contains one positive integer number L (1≤L≤105)%%ZSMJ18%% representing length of the period. Second line contains one positive integer number A (1≤A≤10100000)%%ZSMJ19%%.
output: One positive integer number representing smallest positive number that is periodic with length L%%ZSMJ20%% and is greater than A%%ZSMJ21%%.
note: In first example 124124 is the smallest number greater than 123456 that can be written with period L = 3 (P = 124).
In the second example 100100 is the smallest number greater than 12345 with period L = 3 (P=100)
